articles.title: Is Kikkoman (TSE:2801) Reasonable After A 49% Share Price Run?
articles.summary: Kikkoman has delivered a strong share price run, and the question now is whether that move is in step with the cash flows that ultimately support its valuation. With the stock advancing sharply over the past year, investors are starting to focus less on the brand and more on what the current price implies about the durability and growth of its future cash generation. articles.title: Kikkoman (TSE:2801) Could Be 12% Below Fair Value As Wisconsin Expansion Begins
articles.summary: Kikkoman (TSE:2801) has committed $560 million to a new production facility in Jefferson, Wisconsin, its third U.S. plant, to support rising North American demand for soy sauce and related seasonings. Recent trading has been choppy for Kikkoman, with the share price down 9.33% over 30 days but still showing a 17.41% year-to-date share price return and a 30.75% total shareholder return over one year.
